## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Migration 3 must preserve `legacy_email` before dropping it so rollback can recover values missing from the version 2 snapshot.

## Changes

The pull request adds migrations that drop `users.legacy_email` and `orders.coupon_code`. It backs up `orders` and adds a test that checks both drops and the preserved coupon code.

## Critical

- migrations/m0003_drop_legacy_email.py:7 — correctness — Back up users before dropping legacy_email — A user added after migration 2 with a populated `legacy_email` loses that value when migration 3 drops the column. Migration 3 omits the pre-drop `backup_table` call used by migrations 2 and 4. — The migration backups cannot recover that user’s legacy email during rollback. — Fix: Call `backup_table` for `users` at version 3 before the drop and extend `test_drop_retired_columns`.
